title: XV. Of CHRIST alone without Sin.

segments.text:
CHRIST in the truth of our nature, was made like unto us in all things, Sin only except, from which He was clearly void both in His fleſh and in Spirit. He came to be a Lamb without ſpot, who by Sacrifice of Himſelf once made, ſhould take away the ſins of the World: and Sin (as St. John ſaith) was not in
Him. But all we, the reſt, altho' Baptized, and born again in Chriſt, yet offend in many things, and if we ſay we have no ſ••, we deceive our ſelves and the Truth is not in us.
